verdict_text: YES. The script verifies identical name sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor in all three checkpoints before any merge, computes each MLP tensor as base plus 0.4 times each task vector taken against the unmodified base in float32, copies all other tensors from the base unchanged, asserts exactly 48 merged and 160 output tensors, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The only unverifiable point is the external `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper, which is assumed to return a plain name-to-tensor dict with dtypes preserved.
